title: Remove and Refit the Windshield Wiper Pivot Arms
introduction:
The pivot arms attach the wiper blades to the motor-driven shafts at the base of the windshield. Removal uses a puller; installation depends on parking the motor before aligning the blades with the windshield marks.

I treat PARK as the zero mark on a ruler: blade alignment only means something once the mechanism has reached its proper starting point. The drawings show the covers, nuts, puller placement and alignment marks. The missing hood in the pictures is there to improve the view, not to add a hood-removal job.

items.name: Puller and torque equipment
items.detail: Have a Two Leg Puller and a torque wrench suitable for the specified pivot-arm nut torque. The puller drawing shows its legs beneath the arm hub and its center screw bearing on the pivot shaft.

items.name: Windshield reference marks
items.detail: Locate the blade alignment marks on the windshield before refitting. Installation uses these marks after the motor reaches PARK; the drawing does not provide substitute measurements.

items.name: Disable remote start
items.detail: Park on level ground with the parking brake applied and wheels chocked; keep P selected on an automatic or a parked gear on a manual. Keep the engine stopped throughout. Disable remote start, if equipped, through Vehicle settings > Remote Start Setup before dismantling anything. Otherwise, someone could remotely start the car, causing personal injury or death. If the setting needs ignition power, keep the valid intelligent access key inside. From confirmed OFF, press and release START/STOP without pressing either pedal to select engine-off ON. If already ON for the settings, leave it ON rather than toggling it. After the setting change, return ON to OFF by pressing and releasing the button without pressing a pedal; if already OFF, leave it OFF. With the ignition OFF, remove the key from the vehicle before service to prevent another person from starting the engine; an accidental start may cause serious personal injury. Review the applicable [Health and Safety Precautions](#/document/G1693189) before beginning.

items.name: Prevent unauthorized starting
items.detail: Keep the ignition OFF and the key outside during arm removal. The installation sequence deliberately powers the motor with the arms removed: keep everyone and all tools clear of the pivot shafts during that cycle, then leave the wiper stalk in OFF and keep other people away from the controls while fitting the arms. Do not select intermittent wiping or autowipers for this job.

items.name: Personal protection
items.detail: Wear eye and ear protection during service and protective gloves when handling sharp or pointed parts. Failure to use this protection can cause serious personal injury.

items.name: Conditional underhood precautions
items.detail: If access involves working under the hood, inspect all cooling fans with the ignition OFF for damage, cracks or separation. Replace a damaged fan before proceeding: it can separate during operation and cause serious personal injury. If working near a fan, disable it first because it can run with the ignition off and cause personal injury. On vehicles equipped with engine auto start-stop, keep the ignition off whenever working near rotating engine parts; an automatic start can cause serious personal injury.

edits.why: The equipment table identifies the puller required to separate the arm hubs from their pivot shafts.

edits.text: NOTE: Read the removal instructions for installation details as well; some refitting information appears beside the removal actions.
edits.why: In particular, a torque beside a nut-removal instruction is its tightening specification for reassembly.

edits.text: NOTE: The illustrations show the hood removed for clarity.
edits.why: This is an explanation of the view, not an instruction to remove the hood.

edits.text: Remove the nut covers from the round bases of the windshield wiper pivot arms.
edits.why: These covers conceal the retaining nuts at the arm-to-shaft attachments shown along the base of the windshield.

edits.text: Remove the windshield wiper pivot arm retaining nuts. Their installation torque is 26 lb.ft (35 Nm).
edits.why: Removing the nuts releases the retainers; the next operation uses the puller to separate the arm hubs from the shafts.

edits.text: Remove the windshield wiper pivot arms using the General Equipment: Two Leg Puller. Position its legs beneath the arm hub and center its screw on the pivot shaft, as shown. Tighten the screw to draw the hub off the shaft.
edits.why: The puller applies separation force at the hub. I let the tool do that work instead of turning the surrounding cowl into an improvised pry-bar support.

edits.text: Park the Motor and Refit the Arms
Before fitting the arms, establish that the windshield wiper motor has reached PARK using the ignition and wiper-switch actions below.
edits.why: The motor’s resting position provides the reference for placing the blades. Aligning the arms before establishing PARK can give a misleading starting position.

edits.text: Turn the ignition switch to ON.
edits.why: For the Mustang’s keyless controls, keep the engine stopped and the car parked and restrained as above. Bring the valid key inside. From confirmed ignition OFF, press and release START/STOP with both pedals released to select engine-off ON; if already ON, leave it ON rather than toggling it.

edits.text: Operate the windshield wiper switch to run a complete wiper cycle and let the motor return to PARK.
edits.why: The arms are still removed. With people and tools clear of the shafts, briefly move the right-hand wiper stalk downward to its single-wipe position and release it back to OFF. Let the motor complete the cycle and stop at PARK before approaching the pivots. Keep the stalk OFF while fitting the arms; do not leave it in intermittent, automatic or continuous wipe.

edits.text: Refit the windshield wiper pivot arms with the motor parked, using the alignment and fastening actions below.
edits.why: The following actions connect the motor’s parked position to the blade positions marked on the glass.

edits.text: Position the arms so the windshield wiper blades sit inside their corresponding marks on the windshield.
edits.why: Use the actual marks on the glass as the placement references. The figure’s leader lines identify the blade alignment locations.

edits.text: Install the windshield wiper pivot arm nuts and tighten them to 26 lb.ft (35 Nm).
edits.why: The nuts secure the aligned arm hubs to the pivot shafts.

edits.text: Switch the ignition off after securing the pivot arms.
edits.why: From the known engine-off ON state used for parking the motor, press and release START/STOP with both pedals released to switch OFF. If already OFF, leave it OFF. With the ignition OFF, remove the key before fitting the nut covers.

edits.text: Refit the nut covers over the windshield wiper pivot arm attachments.
edits.why: The covers go back after the arms are aligned, the nuts are tightened and the ignition is off. After full assembly, an ordinary operation check can confirm that the fitted arms sweep without interference and return to their alignment marks; it does not diagnose an electrical fault. Keep the car parked and restrained, clear everyone and all tools from the sweep area, and fully defrost the windshield. Do not wipe dry glass or operate an empty washer reservoir. Bring the valid key inside and use the confirmed OFF-to-engine-off-ON button sequence above. Pull the wiper lever toward you to spray the windshield before wiping; briefly move it downward for a single wipe and release it to OFF. Observe the sweep and return from inside the car. If the arms interfere or park away from their marks, stop and correct the installation before driving. After the check, with the pedals released, switch known ON to OFF; leave an already-OFF state alone. With the ignition OFF, remove the key before any reinspection.

editorialRevision.scope: Actual keyless and single-wipe controls, stationary preparation and ordinary postassembly check. Primary action text/35Nm unchanged; independent increment review pending.
